sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Intimidating Presence (Level 1). You don't have to fight. Most people decide not to, just looking at you.

📖 LEARNED: Bodyguard (Level 1). In the wilds, when a blow is falling on someone beside you, you step into it. Once per fight, an attack meant for your ally lands on you instead. It hurts. That's the job.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 2 skills from your past — check your Journal.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Brian Abramowitz. Night security guard. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Lucky Coin, Dispatcher's headset, Hoodie, Seed packet, Field suture kit. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
A man, maybe 40s, with a buzz cut: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
